content.label: Loved this app, but the UI design on the latest update is went from pretty simple and intuitive to confusing.

I’ve been a user for at least 8 years. Recently new episodes stopped downloading so I finally updated the app. I’m note sure when they did the redesign, but wow it’s awful! There is no visual hierarchy, everything is tiny and randomly distributed…a double-rowed horizontally scrolling panel is just crazy. Did AI do this?. And in the end … didn’t help the episode download issue. I can play roughly 1 in 5 new episodes. The others just show loading forever until I give up and begrudgingly go over to Spotify. Disappointed that after such a long run I have to find a new podcast player 😡😡

I started 4 years ago because I heard that podcasts would help with focus! I found mindfulness, studying, and entertaining podcasts! I totally recommend this app! It helped me improve in academics, mindset, and socialization!
Love the smart speed feature and grouping podcasts. Numerous features for efficiency.
To me, overcast is synonymous with podcast. I have a very hard time on devices without it. The recent changes feel fresh and responsive in keeping up with the times. Highly recommended!

You used to be able to set default playback speed for all the episodes in a given podcast. Now you can’t, which is really frustrating, because some podcasters are super slow and some talk a mile a minute. I’m constantly adjusting the playback speed. 

Also, it’s hard to access the speed controls. There’s a button with a clock on it that looks like it might have something to do with speed, but it doesn’t. It was so *easy* to adjust before the stupid rewrite. Now, whenever I’m driving and I want to adjust the playback speed, it feels dangerous. I can’t keep my eyes on the road because I have to look for that teeny little button, and then when those 3 playback speed choices pop up, I can’t just tap the first one or whatever—I have to carefully read the choices because the labels change. 

Why did you have to go and break everything that made Overcast great? You could have just asked users to start paying; you didn’t have to burn everything to the ground.
Recently reinstalled on my device and it’s having problems streaming episodes over a solid WiFi connection. Not sure if it’s a bug or not.

I expect this app to work better than Apple Podcasts when I get used to it, but the start was rough.

My phone stopped working when I downloaded this app. I liked all the podcasts that I wanted to be receiving and notified of. But the default was to have unlimited downloads of each of them. I took longer than I should’ve to figure out this app triggered it, what the problem was with the app, and how to change the defaults. I hope that this skinnier version of it works because it’s now looking very good on my phone storage.
He’s moving on from Apple platforms and is more interested in destroying the environment generating slop code with LLMs.
Great features. Big upgrade for iPhone users.
Been using Overcast for years. Totally love the new overhaul. Super fast loading. Intuitive interface. Improved sleep timer.
The latest updates to Overcast have been fantastic. Love the listening stats, episode images, and the Promos and Reruns filter is *amazing*

i used to have no complaints about overcast and i liked using and happily paid for it to support indepdenent developers, but as of the last few months it refuses to update some
of my podcasts any more frequently than once per week, which is a real bummer, and there is no support option to get help

Difficult to swipe down when playing an episode to get back to get back to playlist. When trying to swipe left to delete an episode in a playlist, it often selects and starts playing that episode instead.

title.label: Used Daily, need to add Transcript features

content.label: Best podcast player in the store, would like to see AI features, capabilities to share snippets,  and manuscripts, these features are requirements to ensure  it stays at the top of the list.
(Edit: Was the best. No longer fetching feeds, even manually)

Best podcast app out there — as long as you don’t need any help if, say, you get locked out of your premium account and you’re still getting charged but can’t actually use it. Honestly will probably just have to shut down my account because I can’t get a reply from them on how to get back in. Though I don’t know if I can do that since I’m locked out, so maybe I’ll just be paying for a service forever that I can’t actually use?

This is the best podcast player you could have for your podcast needs. You aren’t going to find a more caring developer. The developer really cares about his craft. That isn’t something you’re going to get from Apple Podcast or Spotify, that’s for sure. Also love the new UI. I don’t know if this was a previous feature and I’m only learning about it after the update, but being able to “favorite” a specific podcast, nice touch. I’ve always enjoyed/ will continue to enjoy using this app. It’s great!!
I love this app but the playback speed is broken. It constantly resets the playback speed and has made the app unusable for me :(
Mini player with buttons! Thank You!
I like that it has custom speed and silence trimming options
Easy-to-use interface. There aren’t ads in your face all the time. All episodes are uploaded on time, every time. There are no negatives I can even think of.

title.label: Nice little app, but need some serious UI development.

content.label:
It’s a nice little app, but it has some serious navigation issues between the components of such an app. I could be inside of my favorite podcast, but then I can’t escape out to the rest of the podcasts so it’s really unintuitive to use.

I don’t know, maybe in a few different versions it’ll get better

I’ve set everything to only download manually. But it still downloads as many as it can until my phone is full, without me doing anything. I can’t get it to stop. This is so annoying.
I’ve unfollowed, set the episode limits to 1, set it to manual. I don’t know how else I can tell it to just stop. It won’t stop.
I love Overcast and it breaks my heart that it doesn’t have an android offering yet. It’s turned my old iPhone into an iPod, just because of Overcast.
Never needed to look for a podcast elsewhere.

In the car Apple’s default podcast player would always stop after one show and tell me “You’re not connected to the internet” on my iPad. Well yeah, that’s why I downloaded all these episodes. So I found Overcast and it’s been great, plays nonstop on my commute. One downside is it’s hard to tell if things are actually downloaded, but it seems they are, so not too worrisome. What Is unclear is What Am I Subscribed To. I see the episodes queued up, but did I just pick this one episode, or am I subscribed? Otherwise, really good and easy to use.

The developer has added glassy elements to the app, looks good. However there is absolutely no liquid element to the app. The developer heralds himself as being a great app developer on his podcast, but doesn’t understand Liquid Glass. Should download Liftin’, Foodnoms, and Craft to see apps that implemented Liquid Glass well and in its FULL form.
I can’t get priority to work on my playlist. The sorting seems wacky.
It used to work flawlessly, but with some earlier updates now you have to disconnect from VPN in order to download some episodes
This show makes me laugh. I love the banter between Cole and Catherine.

Didn’t think I’d find an alternative so fast. Overcast won out over competitor apps. It has all the top podcasts that I love, easy to set up, a lot of personalization features. I highly recommend to anyone DONE with the other app.

Constantly pauses my podcasts for no reasons. When I listen WHILE it’s downloading, it will pause every minute and only restart if I open up the app and press play. Closing the app and restarting it does nothing. Just use Spotify

title.label: Great in iPhone, not so much on Watch

content.label: Works as advertised when playing on the iPhone. So if I was rating it just on the basis of its experience on the iPhone, then I’d rate this a 4 or 5. But I rate it a little lower as a synchronized and seamless experience between the iPhone and Apple Watch. It just isn’t efficient when playing podcasts on my Apple Watch. My biggest gripe is that the progress tracking tends to lose its place. So when I try to advance or rewind, the Watch version of the app restarts the podcast from the beginning the current episode.

title.label: No longer able to download or play most podcasts

content.label: I’m not sure what’s going on, but in the last few weeks, this app consistently fails to download and play episodes. I’m having to listen on other apps and websites if I don’t want to be cut off after three minutes. I’m really frustrated, because I’ve used Overcast for years, and if it would work, I’d prefer it over all my other options.

I expected more from this app when I looked at other reviews and the description. But in reality it looks like some kind of unfinished piece of work.

I tried using this app for my podcasts for a few days, but when I saw that the video episode played only as audio and there was no option to play the video, I realized this app wasn't for me. This is the first time I've encountered this in a podcast client.

title.label: Developer cares and continues to improve overcast

content.label:
Marco continues to maintain and improve overcast over time. Adding features requested and addressing complaints as much as he can. 

It shows in a really nice podcast app which I have personally loved using for ~10 years. 

The latest UI changes for iOS 26 have been welcome. I think we have really hit a perfect UI as of now with where everything is.

I’ve been an overcast user for many years, and I recommend it to everyone! I enjoy the ability to create quickly and easily create curated playlists, the ability to adjust playback speed and use the “smart speed” feature without losing voice quality (plus the app says I’ve saved hundreds of hours), and little known add-ons like being able to cut out starting and ending podcast commercials via the “skip intro/outro” feature. Truly one of my favorite apps and I am a committed user for life! Thank you Marco (the creator).
Love the ability to customize so many features, and hide those I’m not using to create an incredibly clean UI. Hands down the best user interface and user experience design of any podcast player.

title.label: Go to, but full of bugs on new iOS operating system

content.label: This is my go to podcast app and I have all my collections on it so I really value it and use it a lot. But it’s also been very buggy with the new iOS operating system. Buttons don’t work or get oddly  blended together with other buttons that kill a ton of functionality in the app.

I don’t normally write reviews, but this is a great app. The UI is well-designed, intuitive. It has many considerate features, such as the ads being small and embedded in a space on the bottom of the screen, favorite podcasts are easy to find or pin. Audio quality is great and I trust in the data privacy. I always aim to support open-source and small dev projects and this is one of the best-executed apps I’ve seen. The only feedback I’d like to provide is that the search function/algorithm could use some work. If I have a specific episode in mind with a certain guest, it’s not all too easy to find. I typically search in Apple Podcasts and come back to Overcast to save and listen to it. 
Thank you to Marco, the solo developer behind it! You’ve made something awesome.

Great alternative to the ‘Apple Dominion’ world.  Especially when i discovered the options and settings like ‘Mark all as read’ and swipping features.   Often times, with players and podcasts, the getting and obtaining podcasts is NOT the issue, but removing and cleaning and preventing download bloating is THE issue.   No one wants 100 gigs of old podcast episodes on their phones.  Thank you Overcast!!!
This is the best podcast app for all your podcast needs. I like it so much better than Apple pod etc.I would recommend this to anyone

title.label: Loyal user for many years but playback bugs are crippling

content.label: I have used overcast as my sole podcast player since the very beginning. However I had to switch to Apple Podcasts recently due to the playback bug where skipping ahead on a podcast when the episode hasn’t been downloaded skips to the next episode/show entirely. This nuked the entire listening experience, as I had to stop whatever I was doing to find my place again. I followed various bug reports but after months had to make the switch for my own listening sanity. And I’m sorry to say it but I haven’t looked back.

I use this app on a daily basis, multiple times a day. I wouldn’t choose another app for my podcast listening workflow. This has been best in class for years.

All apps go through transitions at times where outcomes don’t match the best intentions. This was one of them. I was honest in a prior review about a poor download experienced by myself where I live in without mobile connectivity and only on a local WLAN. It was infuriating and made me reconsider. Which, is why I left a negative review. I rarely do this.

I can now attest that the download experience has superseded the original experience prior to the rough patch. Thank you for focusing on this and many other quality of life improvements to the app!

I have and always will remain a permanent subscriber.

title.label: UX refresh was pointless and backwards

content.label: Moving from a paged view where you would use a top left arrow to go back, to a bottom arrow to pull the page down is confusing to muscle memory and provides zero benefit of the user. It’s still confusing months later and angers me every time that you works destroy a 5-star app like this. You also removed the highlighting from the currently playing episodes in the episodes list so I have to painfully read each title to find out which is playing. So disappointing.
Navigation is the worst. Bring back Stitcher.

I stick with Overcast due to downloads. However, opening the app 2 days after the podcast aired to find it not downloaded is unacceptable. I’m now stuck in an area without WiFi and Cell so this really sucks.

Marco’s petty behavior of making this app incompatible with Google speakers only hurts himself. He created one neat little feature to things speed up and now thinks he’s the GOAT of podcast apps. If the podcast goes faster but won’t “play next” or “play from the queue” what’s the point? This app sucks and so does Marco Arment’s attitude.
